name: browser-use
headline: ai tools for streamlined automation
short_description: Collection of reusable AI tools including Claude Code skills and MCP servers for enhanced development. Benefits operations teams by automating workflows and improving efficiency. Connects to Flutter/Dart development environments and supports Claude agents.
author: calvingit

sections.overview:
The ai-tools skill is a collection of reusable AI tools that includes Claude Code skills and MCP servers designed to enhance development workflows. It provides automation capabilities that benefit operations teams by streamlining workflows and improving efficiency. The skill integrates with Flutter and Dart development environments and supports Claude agents for extended functionality.
Automate repetitive development tasks in Flutter/Dart projects using Claude Code skills
Connect MCP servers to Claude agents for enhanced operational workflows
Streamline operations team processes through AI-driven workflow automation
Integrate reusable AI tools across multiple development environments
This AI tool automates the initial triage of customer support tickets for a SaaS company, categorizing and prioritizing tickets based on content and urgency.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/calvingit/ai-tools`
